workstream: Assess nimbalyst for adoptable improvements to agent-rally-point and agent-astronomer
description: Three read-only assessment agents study a local clone of nimbalyst (~/dev/git-folder/nimbalyst) along disjoint facets, then a synthesis agent merges their findings into a prioritized adoption roadmap. Each agent only writes its own note file under docs/nimbalyst-assessment/, so write boundaries are disjoint and the agents can run in parallel. Reads of the nimbalyst clone are read-only and external to this repo. Coordinated through rally: each task claims its note path, checks before write, and posts an artifact with evidence.

tasks.intent: Assess how nimbalyst makes a codebase/repo legible (visual data-model editor, file<->session linking, document-context service, architecture docs) and which patterns agent-rally-point/agent-astronomer could adopt to help users understand repo components
tasks.output: 01-comprehension.md: concrete nimbalyst comprehension patterns with file:line citations, plus mapped adoption ideas

tasks.intent: Assess nimbalyst's UI/UX and design system (CSS variables/theming, dark mode, component library, layout, kanban/session views, WYSIWYG red/green diff approval) and extract adoptable patterns for agent-astronomer's UI
tasks.output: 02-ui-ux.md: design-system + UX patterns with file:line citations, mapped to agent-astronomer improvements

tasks.intent: Assess nimbalyst's multi-agent session/workstream/worktree/git management and compare with agent-rally-point's rally coordination model; identify complementary patterns or a rally<->nimbalyst integration surface
tasks.output: 03-agent-coordination.md: coordination/session-management comparison with citations, mapped to rally improvements

tasks.intent: Merge the three facet notes into a single prioritized adoption roadmap for agent-rally-point and agent-astronomer; no execution, read the three notes and write the synthesis
tasks.output: 00-synthesis.md: ranked, effort-tagged improvement roadmap citing the three facet notes
